title: Irish Buckwheat Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the earthiness of buckwheat with the richness of Irish sausage.
instructions: Cook the Irish sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage mixture, sliced carrots, and chopped onion.
Add the buckwheat flour and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
